PHP.1.1.text: Paul and Timotheus, the servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus which are at Philippi, with the bishops and deacons:

PHP.1.2.text: Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.

changes.reason: Glossary entry g-unto-to directs this sense of 'unto' to be updated to 'to' (R3).

PHP.1.3.text: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,

PHP.1.4.text: Always in every prayer of mine for you all making request with joy,

PHP.1.5.text: For your fellowship in the gospel from the first day until now;

PHP.1.6.text: Being confident of this very thing, that he which has begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ:

changes.reason: Mechanical update (R2)

PHP.1.7.text: Even as it is fitting for me to think this of you all, because I have you in my heart; inasmuch as both in my bonds, and in the defence and confirmation of the gospel, you all are partakers of my grace.

changes.reason: 'Meet' in this adjectival sense means 'suitable/fitting', which a modern reader would not understand; 'fitting' carries the same sense (R4).

evidence.note: Parallel KJV uses of 'it is meet' (JOB.34.31, 2TH.1.3) confirm the sense 'fitting, proper', not 'to encounter'.

changes.reason: Mechanical update (R1)

PHP.1.8.text: For God is my witness, how greatly I long after you all in the affection of Jesus Christ.

changes.reason: R4: KJV "record" here means testimony borne by a witness, which a modern reader would take for a written account, so it must change.

evidence.note: μάρτυς (G3144) is glossed "witness", settling the KJV sense of "record".
JOB.16.19 sets "my witness" and "my record" in parallel, confirming record = witness.

changes.reason: R4 and glossary g-bowels-affection: the KJV sense is the seat of tender feeling, not entrails.

evidence.note: σπλάγχνοις (G4698) is glossed "affection/entrails"; the context of longing fixes the affective sense.

PHP.1.10.text: That you may approve things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offence till the day of Christ;

PHP.1.13.text: So that my bonds in Christ are manifest in all the palace, and in all other places;

PHP.1.14.text: And many of the brothers in the Lord, growing confident by my bonds, are much more bold to speak the word without fear.

PHP.1.15.text: Some indeed preach Christ even of envy and strife; and some also of good will:

PHP.1.16.text: The one preach Christ of contention, not sincerely, supposing to add affliction to my bonds:

PHP.1.17.text: But the other of love, knowing that I am set for the defence of the gospel.

PHP.1.18.text: What then? notwithstanding, every way, whether in pretence, or in truth, Christ is preached; and I therein do rejoice, yea, and will rejoice.

PHP.1.19.text: For I know that this shall turn to my salvation through your prayer, and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

PHP.1.20.text: According to my earnest expectation and my hope, that in nothing I shall be ashamed, but that with all boldness, as always, so now also Christ shall be magnified in my body, whether it be by life, or by death.

PHP.1.21.text: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

PHP.1.24.text: Nevertheless to abide in the flesh is more needful for you.

PHP.1.25.text: And having this confidence, I know that I shall abide and continue with you all for your furtherance and joy of faith;

PHP.1.26.text: That your rejoicing may be more abundant in Jesus Christ for me by my coming to you again.

PHP.1.27.text: Only let your conduct be as it becomes the gospel of Christ: that whether I come and see you, or else be absent, I may hear of your affairs, that you stand fast in one spirit, with one mind striving together for the faith of the gospel;

PHP.3.1.text: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not grievous, but for you it is safe.

changes.reason: Glossary entry g-brethren-brothers marks brethren as archaic in this sense, so it becomes brothers per R3.

PHP.3.2.text: Beware of dogs, beware of evil workers, beware of the mutilation.

changes.reason: The KJV sense of 'concision' is cutting short or mutilation, while modern English uses it for brevity, so the word must change to keep the meaning (R4).

evidence.note: 'concision' occurs nowhere else in the KJV, so its sense must be settled from this verse alone.

PHP.3.3.text: For we are the circumcision, which worship God in the spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh.

PHP.3.12.text: Not as though I had already attained, either were already perfect: but I follow after, if that I may grasp that for which also I am grasped by Christ Jesus.

changes.reason: R3: "apprehend" is no longer understood in its KJV sense of laying hold of, and "grasp" is the closest one-word equivalent.

evidence.note: καταλαμβάνω (#12, #16) is glossed "to grasp", confirming the sense is lay hold of, not understand or arrest.
The only other KJV use of "apprehend" is 2CO.11.32 in the legal sense "arrest", so the modern reader has no help from elsewhere in the KJV.

evidence.note: Correction per rev-2-mw7v50j2-ba: most KJV uses of 'necessity' mean compulsion or requirement (e.g. 1CO.9.16, 2CO.9.7, HEB.7.12).
